Name: Family Assassin
Source: Lyres Guide to Risk and Reward
Information: Among the most feared of the Family members, these assassins operate quickly and ruthlessly. They use a special artificial toxin called stiffrot to paralyze their targets, then swiftly assassinate them. They are masters of swift, precise combat and are feared across Retia as some of the most well-trained killers to walk anonymously among civilized folk.

traits.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
traits.description: The assassin deals an extra 21 (6d6) damage when it hits with a weapon attack using a finesse or ranged weapon, as long as it has advantage on the attack roll or one of its allies is within 5 feet of its target and not incapacitated. It cannot benefit from this feature if it has disadvantage on the attack roll.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The assassin makes two weapon attacks.

actions.name: Mounted Blades
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d6 + 5) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, taking 21 (6d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Revolver
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) piercing damage, and if the target is within the weapon’s normal range they must succeed a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw, taking an additional 28 (8d6) piercing damage on a failure.

actions.name: Stiffrot (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The assassin makes a single weapon attack using their mounted blades against a target within range. If they hit and the target fails the Constitution saving throw against the poison damage, the creature is paralyzed for 1 minute in addition to the damage from the attack. The paralyzed creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of their turns, ending the effect on a success.

bonus_actions.name: Kill Rush
bonus_actions.description: The assassin moves up to its movement speed and makes a single attack against a creature within range. If this attack hits it qualifies for Sneak Attack as long as it does not have disadvantage.
